title: message-reactions/1.0/reactions
description: The sender's complete, current set of emoji reactions to one message. Replaces any set the sender stated for that message earlier.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. These messages are always sent authenticated, so it is always present, and it -- not anything in the body -- says who the message is from.

pthid.description: In a group conversation (group-chat/1.0), the group's id. Absent in a one-to-one conversation.

created_time.description: UTC epoch seconds. Of a sender's statements about one message, the one with the latest value is the one that stands.

id.description: The id of the message referred to. Compared case-insensitively.

author.description: The DID that sent the message referred to, as the referring party knows it.

to.description: The message reacted to. A message reference; a snippet is not used here.

emoji.description: Distinct emoji, each one emoji as a Unicode sequence, in the order the sender added them. Empty means the sender has no reactions on the message.
